prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: Across all five frames, a tabletop lies directly in front of and below the camera, about 0.3–0.7 m away, with a white sheet near the center, a dark glue gun near the upper center, scissors to its lower right, and small craft materials partly visible along the left edge. The camera wearer’s two hands and forearms occupy the lower foreground within about 0.2–0.5 m, holding and turning a small green object above the near edge of the table; the hands intermittently occlude the object and parts of the white sheet. In frames 1–3 the view remains mostly forward and the tabletop objects retain similar positions, while the green object shifts slightly rightward and closer to the center between the hands. In frame 4 the camera turns markedly to the right, revealing more of the room and another person roughly 0.5–1 m to the right-front, with an arm extended across the table within their reach; their head is only partly visible, so their gaze toward the camera cannot be established. In frame 5 the view turns back toward the tabletop, the other person is mostly out of frame except for a hand and forearm entering from the upper right, and a longer green piece lies on the white sheet about 0.4–0.6 m in front of the camera wearer.
